items.informal_name: Total Degree in a Variable of a Product of Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} {n : σ} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R),
  (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) → MvPolynomial.degreeOf n (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, MvPolynomial.degreeOf n (f i)
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of indices and a function $ f $ assigning non-zero multivariate polynomials to each element of $ s $, the total degree of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f(i) $ in the variable $ n $ is equal to the sum of the total degrees of each $ f(i) $ in $ n $, i.e., $ \deg_n\left(\prod_{i \in s} f(i)\right) = \sum_{i \in s} \deg_n(f(i)) $.

items.informal_name: Additivity of Total Degree in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} {n : σ} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} [NoZeroDivisors R],
  p ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0 → MvPolynomial.degreeOf n (p * q) = MvPolynomial.degreeOf n p + MvPolynomial.degreeOf n q
items.informal_description: For non-zero multivariate polynomials $ p $ and $ q $, the total degree of their product in a variable $ n $ is equal to the sum of their individual total degrees in $ n $, i.e., $\deg_n(pq) = \deg_n(p) + \deg_n(q)$.

items.informal_name: Additivity of Degree Multisets in Multivariate Polynomial Multiplication
items.type:

  p ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0 → (p * q).degrees = p.degrees + q.degrees
items.informal_description: For any non-zero multivariate polynomials $ p $ and $ q $, the degree multiset of their product $ p \cdot q $ is equal to the multiset sum of the degree multisets of $ p $ and $ q $, i.e., $\mathrm{degrees}(p \cdot q) = \mathrm{degrees}(p) + \mathrm{degrees}(q)$.

items.informal_name: Total Degree of Product of Non-Zero Polynomials Over a Domain Equals Sum of Degrees
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 → (f * g).totalDegree = f.totalDegree + g.totalDegree
items.informal_description: For any non-zero multivariate polynomials $ f $ and $ g $ over a domain $ R $, the total degree of their product $ f \cdot g $ is equal to the sum of the total degrees of $ f $ and $ g $.

items.informal_name: Leading Monomial of Product Equals Sum Under Monomial Order
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {m : MonomialOrder σ} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {ι : Type u_3}
  {P : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, P i ≠ 0) → m.degree (∏ i ∈ s, P i) = ∑ i ∈ s, m.degree (P i)
items.informal_description: Given a commutative semiring $ R $ with no zero divisors, a type $ \sigma $, and a finite set $ s $ of indices, if each polynomial $ P(i) $ for $ i \in s $ is non-zero, then the leading monomial of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} P(i) $ under a monomial order $ m $ is equal to the sum of the leading monomials of each $ P(i) $.

items.type:

items.informal_description: Given a degree function $\text{degt}$ on an additive monoid algebra $R[A]$ satisfying $\text{degt}(0) \geq 0$ and $\text{degt}(a) + \text{degt}(b) \leq \text{degt}(a + b)$ for all $a, b \in A$, and a list $l$ of elements in $R[A]$, the sum of the infima of $\text{degt}$ over the supports of each element in $l$ is less than or equal to the infimum of $\text{degt}$ over the support of the product of all elements in $l$.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T]
  {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A), ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For a commutative semiring $ R $ and an additive commutative monoid $ A $, let $ \text{degt} : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfy $ \text{degt}(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \text{degt}(a + b) \geq \text{degt}(a) + \text{degt}(b) $. For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : s \to R[A] $, the sum of the infima of $ \text{degt} $ over the supports of each $ f(i) $ is less than or equal to the infimum of $ \text{degt} $ over the support of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f(i) $.

items.informal_name: Degree Inequality for Multiset Products in Additive Monoid Algebras
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (m : Multiset (AddMonoidAlgebra R A)),
        (Multiset.map (fun f => f.support.inf degt) m).sum ≤ m.prod.support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For a degree function $\deg$ on an additive monoid algebra $R[A]$ satisfying $\deg(0) \geq 0$ and $\deg(a + b) \geq \deg(a) + \deg(b)$, and for any multiset $m$ of elements in $R[A]$, the sum of the minimum degrees of the supports of the elements in $m$ is less than or equal to the minimum degree of the support of the product of $m$.
